channel.description: Latest articles from Just A Pinch Recipes (justapinch.com)

item.title: Crock Pot Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes and Ham
item.description: We made the Kicked Up creamy version of this recipe and that is just exactly what it was. We like that this is cooked in the Crock Pot... makes for a very easy meal. Great if you have leftover holiday ham. The cheese sauce is just enough... it's so good!

item.title: Hot Bacon Cheese Spread
item.description: After one bite, we could see why this hot bacon cheese spread is so popular. Warm and super cheesy, there are bits of bacon in every bite, adding a wonderful smoky flavor. Onions add a nice pop of sweetness next to the savory Colby Jack cheese and bacon. Preparing it in a bread bowl makes for a pretty presentation and slightly elevates this simple dip for the holidays. Make sure to have crackers handy for dipping because you'll want to enjoy every last bit of this hot bacon dip.

item.title: Crab Dip
item.description: Rich and savory, we couldn't stop eating this crab dip. It's creamy and cheesy with crab throughout. Super easy to make, serve with pita chips, celery, or a buttery cracker for a wonderful appetizer. This is on the saltier side, though. If needed, slightly cut back on the garlic salt and onion salt. It will still be delicious!

item.title: Sauerkraut and Pork for New Year's Day
item.description: We loved this recipe for sauerkraut pork chops because it's easy to make, and the result is delicious. The pork is tender and juicy. Sauerkraut adds a tangy and savory flavor to the dish. Broth helps to keep the pork moist. Super tender, the pork can be cut with a fork. It's a hearty and satisfying meal that'll make you feel cozy and happy. We used the original scrumptious recipe and browned the meat directly in the Instant Pot on the saute setting. item.title: Hot Chicken Appetizers
item.description: Want a fun and easy party appetizer? Try these hot chicken appetizers. They're warm and creamy with just the right amount of crunch from puff pastry. Once baked, the puff pastry is flaky and crispy. Canned chicken is transformed by adding cherry tomatoes, chopped onion, baby spinach, cream cheese, and Parmesan cheese to create a rich and savory filling. This is a versatile bite-sized appetizer that could be served as a basic party appetizer, but it's also a little bit elevated for a special part

item.title: Smoky Stuffed Mushrooms
item.description: All you'll smell is bacon while these smoky stuffed mushrooms bake. They're filled with creamy, cheesy goodness mixed with onions, mushrooms, and (you guessed it) bacon. They're a tasty appetizer for watching football or a holiday party.

item.title: Mixed Greens
item.description: The combination of mixed greens in this recipe reminds us of an old-fashioned dish that a grandparent would make. It's a healthy way to prepare a bowl of greens. Liquid smoke adds a subtle smokiness to the large pot of greens. A good recipe to serve a crowd. With spinach, collard greens, and turnip greens, it's a tasty way to get an ample amount of greens.

item.title: Cabbage and Sausage Soup
item.description: A super comforting and easy soup to throw together. The sausage adds a wonderful smoky flavor and richness. Cabbage, carrots, and potatoes are basic ingredients but add a lot of heartiness and flavor. A lazy meal on a cold day when you don't feel like cooking.

item.title: Turkey, Spinach, and Swiss Mini Quiche
item.description: We loved the mix of flavors in these mini quiches. Each is filled with spinach, chopped turkey, and shredded Swiss cheese. Sour cream and heavy cream help to make the eggs light and fluffy. Lower in carbs, they're a good finger food for brunch and a great meal prep recipe.

item.title: Apple Cinnamon Crock Pot Oatmeal
item.description: Want a hearty and healthy breakfast? Make a batch of this apple cinnamon Crock Pot oatmeal. The steel cut oats keep their chewy texture after simmering in the slow cooker, unlike rolled oats that would become mushy. The final result is a creamy oatmeal filled with tender, yet crisp, cinnamon-spiced apples. We didn't use the optional raisins, but did add chopped nuts and loved their crunch.
